unknowns: concrete initial adapters and external contracts
version update and emergency revocation semantics

task_authority.scope: task_authorized in the gate means task identity and scope have applicable sufficient authority for the contemplated incorporation. After revocation this may be a new incorporation authorization; it does not require the revoked original grant to remain active. Original grant remains provenance and upper bound absent explicit scope change.
task_authority.concurrency: one supervised execution at a time

storage.initial_estimate: proposed by supervisor, justified and checked before task consent
storage.enlargement: preflight -> explicit consent for affected dimensions -> revalidate admission
unknowns: physical versus logical accounting per filesystem

promotion.base: unchanged and verified under a coordination mechanism; a prior hash alone is insufficient
promotion.evidence: all applicable criteria current and satisfied
promotion.authority: current task permission, plus fresh incorporation authorization after revocation
promotion.write_ownership: no claim of protection from uncoordinated third-party writers without enforcement
promotion.rollback: only recoverable base and proven preservation of unrelated changes; otherwise blocked
unknowns: durable write journal and recovery protocol
logical commit point of multi-file incorporation

revocation_order.origin: independent interrogation Q-INT-T01; proposal adjudicated ANSWERED for documents
revocation_order.rule: single coordinator serializes acceptance of revocation and issuance of incorporation writes by task
revocation_order.acceptance: local acknowledgement only after durable revocation event; UI send is not local acceptance
revocation_order.after_acceptance: Deny incorporation writes relying on the revoked authority epoch; separately scoped recovery remains permitted. New incorporation requires a later sufficient authorization bound to the latest epoch, task, candidate, base and operation.
revocation_order.in_flight: earlier emitted operations are not assumed cancelled; observe completion before restoration
revocation_order.crash: emission without durable completion becomes UNKNOWN/IN_FLIGHT after restart and blocks restoration until reconciliation
limitations: durability does not prove no OS write happened
uncoordinated external writers prevent a blanket safety guarantee
revocation_order.authorization_epoch: Every accepted revocation advances epoch and invalidates any previous fresh-incorporation eligibility; derive eligibility from identified, applicable approvals, never an unversioned boolean.

negative_scenarios.violation: Incorporation write relies on revoked authority epoch without sufficient later applicable authorization; excludes separately authorized recovery writes.
